text:
maya: Quick heads-up — US office holiday next Tue (May 12). Proposing we shift the biweekly release window one day later or use a holiday fallback plan. Prefer keeping cadence if on-call + QA can cover. Thoughts?
jamal: I'd avoid moving the train if possible. Fallback proposal: cutoff Mon EOD, small Wed canary, full rollout Thu. Gives QA a buffer.
chris: Agreed with Jamal. Also we need a version bump and changelog finalized before cutoff. I can do the tagging once changelog PR is merged.
alex: I can take the changelog PR today. @chris ping me when you have the list of entries. Added a tentative calendar event for Wed canary — see calendar link. :calendar:
sophia: On-call coverage: I can cover Wed-Thu 9am-5pm PT. @oncall-bot can you confirm rotation overlaps?
oncall-bot: Rotation check: maya primary Tue, jamal backup Tue. Wed primary: jamal. Paging policy unchanged: sev >= P2.
maya: OK. Branch coordination: let's lock release/* branches Mon 17:00 PT (cutoff). Exceptions must go through #eng-releases triage with an explicit changelog PR and reviewer.
jamal: Also note dedicated-customer maintenance Fri 02:00-06:00 UTC — avoid infra-impacting deploys then.
chris: Quick tag snippet I'll use after merge: ```git checkout release/next && git pull origin release/next && git tag -a vX.Y.Z -m "release" && git push origin --tags``` I can run it once alex confirms changelog merge.
ella: I'll ping reviewers for CRs now — @frontend @infra please aim to review by Mon 12:00 PT. /cc @sophia
maya: Summary: cutoff Mon 17:00 PT, changelog PR by EOD Mon, canary Wed, full rollout Thu, on-call covered. If no objections I'll update the handbook and lock branches. :thumbsup:
alex: :thumbsup: no objections from my side.
sophia: No objections. I'll update the release board and flip the canary card to "in progress".
